_readme: The two calibration sets of COLLECTION.md §4, PRE-REGISTERED 2026-09-06 before any verdict or entry_stage was written. The stage key was assembled from external documents first (one cited round announcement per row, web-verified in this run) and the blind pass then judged the same rows through the production protocol with this file out of context. Scores and the layer decisions they forced are in scratch/gate.md.

membership_traps._note: Benchmark's trap classes are unusually rich because the firm hired four partners out of other firms between 2021 and 2026 (Grimshaw from Thrive, Lazarte from Wildlife, Randle from Kleiner/Founders Fund, Altman from his own Alt Capital) and because two long-tenured partners run personal vehicles. Every FALSE row below is a roster name on a real Form D whose seat belongs to another firm, to the partner personally, or to the partner's own company — the exact defect the ledger exists to kill. Expected verdicts were written from the filing dates against the roster tenure windows, before the grind.

stage_golden._note: 25 rows, not the 30-40 the playbook asks for, and the reason is investor-specific: Benchmark publishes NO announcement archive of its own (no site since 2013, no blog, no press page), so unlike Accel or Creandum every key row costs one external search rather than one CMS read. 25 verified rounds is what the run's search budget could carry against an A/B pass on a large visible slice; the shortfall is recorded rather than papered over. Every row below names the round, the year and the citation, and each was verified in this run 2026-09-06.
